glyph.isekai_mahou.boogie_woogie.desc: Arcane effect (Jujutsu Kaisen tribute). CLAP! You swap places with the creature hit. On Self: with the creature in your crosshair (24 blocks, Expand +) or, if none, with YOUR most recent projectile (arrow, snowball... it becomes the marker). A swapped enemy is Stunned for 0.5 s. Never swaps with bosses, NPCs, mounts, or players outside your party (except PvP enemies). One swap per cast.
glyph.isekai_mahou.kazuma_steal.desc: Arcane effect (Konosuba tribute). "Steal!": tries to steal ONE thing from the creature hit (up to 3 per cast). Chance 50%% + 6%% per Luck point + 8%% per Amplify (max 90%%). You may get its held item, something from its loot table... or a striped sock. Each creature can only be robbed once; bosses only give gold nuggets. Never steals from players, NPCs or inside cities.
glyph.isekai_mahou.flame_alchemy.desc: Fire effect (Fullmetal Alchemist tribute). SNAP! A line of sparks runs from your hand and explodes PRECISELY at the point hit (Self: at your crosshair point, up to 32 blocks): 9 Fire damage in a 2.5 radius (Expand +, max 12 targets) and Burning for 4 s. Breaks no blocks and sets no fires; each creature burns only once per cast. In rain or water: useless (30%% damage, no fire).
glyph.isekai_mahou.alchemy_wall.desc: Earth effect (Fullmetal Alchemist tribute). Hands to the ground: a 5×3 stone wall rises at the block hit (Expand +2 width, max 9) and crumbles by itself after 8 s (Extend +). Self: the wall rises 3 blocks in front of you. On an enemy: stone spikes burst from the ground — 8 Earth damage, launch and Rooted 1 s. Temporary stone; never in cities, active towers/dungeons, or where you can't build.
glyph.isekai_mahou.zoltraak.desc: Arcane effect (Frieren tribute). The "ordinary offensive magic": a thin ray of pure magic, cheap and reliable. 6 Arcane damage and the ray goes through: hits 1 more enemy up to 8 blocks behind (+1 per Pierce) for 60%%. Self: fires straight at the creature in your crosshair (32 blocks).
glyph.isekai_mahou.geass.desc: Shadow effect (Code Geass tribute). An order through eye contact (the target must see you). WEAK creature (max health up to 40, +25%% per Amplify): "OBEY!" — fights for you for 12 s (Extend +) and never touches you or your party; cast while SNEAKING: "STOP!" — Stunned 5 s. Strong creatures, bosses or enemy players only hesitate (Stunned 1 s). Once per creature; never kills.
glyph.isekai_mahou.chain_jail.desc: Arcane effect (Hunter x Hunter tribute). Chains bind the enemy: 2 damage, Rooted 3 s (Extend +) and Silenced 1 s. Against SPIDERS and DARK creatures (arthropods, undead) — Emperor Time —: 6 damage, bound twice as long and Silenced 3 s. Bosses: 1 s at most. Self: binds the enemy in your crosshair (20 blocks).
glyph.isekai_mahou.holy_chain.desc: Light effect (Hunter x Hunter tribute). The chain coils around the ally (or you): heals 5 and removes 1 bad effect (+1 per Amplify).
glyph.isekai_mahou.dowsing_chain.desc: Arcane effect (Hunter x Hunter tribute). Self: the pendulum swings — enemies within 24 blocks (Expand +, max 48) glow for 8 s (Extend +) and you see how many there are and where the nearest is. On an enemy: "the chain doesn't lie" — it glows for 15 s and you see its health, armor and effects.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tengai_shinsei.desc: Earth effect (Naruto tribute). A GIANT rock descends from the sky over 2.5 s onto the point hit (Self: your crosshair, up to 64 blocks); a circle on the ground warns where. Impact: 30 Earth damage in a 6 radius (Expand +, max 12; up to 30 targets; bosses ×0.7) and launch. A small crater only with spell destruction on (never in cities, towers or dungeons). One rock per cast; Amplify = bigger rock.
glyph.isekai_mahou.black_flash.desc: Shadow augment (Jujutsu Kaisen tribute). RHYTHM: after casting, once the cooldown ends you hear a "ting" at a slightly random moment. Cast the same spell right after it (within 0.25 s) = BLACK FLASH: its next 6 hits deal ×2.5 (max +60 each) with black and red sparks, and you enter THE ZONE for 10 s (wider window, +10%% damage). Pressing before the ting just casts normally.
glyph.isekai_mahou.starburst_stream.desc: Arcane augment (Sword Art Online tribute). Every hit becomes a 16-strike flurry: 15 more blue and white dual-blade slashes over 1.5 s (+95%% damage in total, the last one strongest). You are locked into the sequence (Slowness IV 1.7 s). Up to 4 flurries at once.
glyph.isekai_mahou.excalibur_light.desc: Light augment (Fate tribute). Raise the blade (+0.5 s cast time): Expand +2 and Pierce +3 on what comes before, +15%% damage (+40%% vs undead). After a BEAM: the ray becomes huge and a golden wave sweeps over it.
item.isekai_mahou.lj_striped_sock.lore: Stolen with all your Luck. Completely useless.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_j.boogie_no: Clap! ...but there was no one to swap places with.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_j.warded: A barrier blocks the swap (protected area).
message.isekai_mahou.legends_j.steal_pla: Your hand slipped — you can't steal from another player.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_j.steal_tow: Stealing inside the city? No way!
message.isekai_mahou.legends_j.geass_no_: No eye contact — the Geass doesn't take.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_j.geass_obe: Lelouch vi Britannia commands you: OBEY!
message.isekai_mahou.legends_j.geass_sto: Lelouch vi Britannia commands you: STOP!
message.isekai_mahou.legends_j.geass_res: %s is too strong: it only hesitates for a moment.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_j.geass_onc: The Geass only works once on %s.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_j.emperor_t: Emperor Time! Your eyes turn scarlet.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_j.dowse_non: The pendulum hangs still: no enemies nearby.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_j.dowse_fou: Pendulum: %s enemy(ies) — the nearest to the %s, %s blocks away.
